Even if their price is lower, policy strictly prohibits placing orders for food-contact items with any supplier lacking a valid, verified certificate (an expired or missing certificate counts as no certificate). 

To purchase from them, the supplier must first submit an accredited food-grade test report (e.g., from an FSSAI-notified laboratory) or valid conformity certificate, which must be uploaded and verified in Bahi before any order can be placed.
